string.text: Base Ghillie visibility coefficient multiplier. Lower values makes you less visible over from a distance
Base NPC field of view multiplier. Lower values makes you less visible from their sides

Reduces ghillie camouflage within 60 metres for 3 seconds after an unsuppressed shot. Each shot refreshes the timer. Higher values increase visual detection. Default: 60. Reworked noise alerts also remain active.
